The bakery

Some mornings on Sardar Patel Road begin the way they have since 1952: trays of bread out of the oven, pastries under glass, and a queue that knows exactly what it came for. Adyar Bakery is a Chennai institution that never needed to become anything else: a neighbourhood counter where the baking is done here, every day, by hand.

110, Sardar Patel Road, Baktavatsalm Nagar, Adyar, Chennai 600020.
